items.text_th: ไม่ได้เพชร 300 จากการย้ายมาที่ VNG ครับ ต้องทำยังไง
items.text_vn: Chuyển sang VNG rồi mà không nhận được 300 kim cương, phải làm sao ạ?
items.text_en: I moved to VNG but didn't get the 300 diamonds. What should I do?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi chuyển sang VNG nhưng không nhận được 300 kim cương thưởng.
items.summary_en: A player moved to VNG but didn't receive the 300-diamond reward.

items.text_th: ขอสอบถามหน่อยค่ะ ภารกิจรถตุ๊กตุ๊กวันที่3 ที่ขุดหาหูฟังของ Kai ที่ชายหาดพลาซ่า นี่ต้องขุดไปเรื่อยๆจนกว่าจะเจอ หรือมีพิกัดจุดหูฟังมั้ยคะ เราขุดเยอะมากไม่เจอสักทีกลัวว่าจะทำผิดค่ะ5555
items.text_vn: Cho mình hỏi chút: nhiệm vụ xe tuk tuk ngày 3, đào tìm tai nghe của Kai ở bãi biển Plaza, là cứ đào mãi tới khi thấy hay có vị trí cụ thể ạ? Mình đào nhiều lắm rồi mà chưa thấy, sợ làm sai haha.
items.text_en: Quick question: for day 3 of the tuk tuk quest, digging for Kai's headphones at Plaza beach, do I just keep digging until I find them, or is there a set spot? I've dug a lot and still nothing, worried I'm doing it wrong haha.
items.summary_vn: Hỏi nhiệm vụ xe tuk tuk ngày 3 (đào tìm tai nghe của Kai) có vị trí cố định không.
items.summary_en: Asks whether day 3 of the tuk tuk quest (digging for Kai's headphones) has a fixed spot.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ขุดไปเรื่อยๆคะ เด่วก็ เจอ สู้ๆ
items.text_vn: Cứ đào tiếp đi, lát là thấy thôi, cố lên!
items.text_en: Just keep digging, you'll find it soon. Hang in there!
items.summary_vn: Khuyên cứ đào tiếp sẽ tìm thấy tai nghe.
items.summary_en: Says to keep digging and the headphones will turn up.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: มันใช้ตัวธรรมดาผสมไม่ได้ใช่ไหมครับ
items.text_vn: Con này không dùng con thường để lai được đúng không ạ?
items.text_en: You can't breed this one using normal ones, right?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi có lai được thú cưng này từ con thường không.
items.summary_en: Asks whether this pet can be bred from normal ones.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: จื่อบ่บักซีเด๋อ😭
items.text_vn: Còn nhớ tui không ông ơi 😭 (?)
items.text_en: Remember me, bro? 😭 (?)
items.summary_vn: Đăng ảnh than thở (tiếng Isan) sau khi tốn nhiều tiền mở thẻ.
items.summary_en: Posts a crying meme (Isan dialect) after spending a lot opening cards.

items.text_th: เปิดเอาการ์ด 6000Bจะบ้าหัวร้อนอย่าเติมเกมส์
items.text_vn: Mở thẻ hết 6000 baht, phát điên, cay quá. Đừng nạp game này.
items.text_en: Spent 6,000 baht opening cards, going crazy, so mad. Don't top up this game.
items.summary_vn: Tốn 6000 baht mở thẻ, bực và khuyên người khác đừng nạp tiền.
items.summary_en: Spent 6,000 baht on cards, angry, tells others not to top up.

items.text_th: สาหัสคัก
items.text_vn: Nặng đô thật sự.
items.text_en: That's brutal.
items.summary_vn: Đồng cảm vì tốn quá nhiều tiền.
items.summary_en: Sympathizes with how much was spent.

items.text_th: ค่าเสียหายเท่าไหร่คะรอบนี้
items.text_vn: Lần này thiệt hại bao nhiêu vậy?
items.text_en: How much did it cost you this time?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi lần này tốn bao nhiêu tiền.
items.summary_en: Asks how much was spent this time.

items.text_th: แล้วเลิกไม่ได้ด้วยนะหมดไปเยอะ
items.text_vn: Mà giờ bỏ cũng không được, đã tốn nhiều quá rồi.
items.text_en: And I can't quit now either, I've already spent so much.
items.summary_vn: Than đã tốn nhiều tiền nên không bỏ được.
items.summary_en: Complains they've spent too much to quit.

items.text_th: แฟนหนูกดให้4โรลออกเลย อิอิ
items.text_vn: Người yêu em quay giùm 4 lượt là ra luôn, hihi.
items.text_en: My boyfriend rolled 4 times for me and got it, hehe.
items.summary_vn: Khoe người yêu quay 4 lượt là ra thẻ cần.
items.summary_en: Brags their partner got the card in 4 rolls.

items.text_th: ทำยังไงให้สัตว์โตไวๆหรอคะ เราพึ่งกลับมาเล่น มีไดโนเสาร์กับมังกรหิน มันขี่หรือทำอะไรได้บ้างมั้ยคะ
items.text_vn: Làm sao cho thú cưng lớn nhanh vậy ạ? Mình mới chơi lại, có khủng long với rồng đá, tụi nó cưỡi được hay làm gì được không ạ?
items.text_en: How do I make pets grow faster? I just came back and have a dinosaur and a stone dragon. Can I ride them or do anything with them?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi quay lại hỏi cách nuôi thú cưng lớn nhanh và có cưỡi được không.
items.summary_en: A returning player asks how to grow pets faster and whether they can be ridden.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เพชร50รับจบ
items.text_vn: 50 kim cương là xong.
items.text_en: 50 diamonds and you're done.
items.summary_vn: Chỉ cách dùng 50 kim cương để thú cưng lớn ngay.
items.summary_en: Says 50 diamonds will grow the pet instantly.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ก็ไม่เห็นจะยากเท่าไรเหลืออีกตั้ง8วัน🤣😆
items.text_vn: Cũng đâu khó lắm, còn tận 8 ngày mà 🤣😆
items.text_en: Doesn't look that hard, there's still 8 days left 🤣😆
items.summary_vn: Đùa về việc sưu tầm thẻ còn 8 ngày (khoe bộ thẻ còn thiếu).
items.summary_en: Jokes about the card collection with 8 days left.

items.text_th: อันแรกยังไม่ครบเลย ชิวๆ
items.text_vn: Bộ đầu còn chưa đủ nữa, thong thả thôi.
items.text_en: I haven't even finished the first set, no rush.
items.summary_vn: Nói chưa xong bộ thẻ đầu nhưng vẫn thong thả.
items.summary_en: Says they haven't finished the first set but aren't worried.

items.text_th: ยังไม่ครบเลยย ทางนี้55555
items.text_vn: Bên này cũng chưa đủ nè haha.
items.text_en: I'm not done either haha.
items.summary_vn: Cũng chưa sưu tầm đủ thẻ.
items.summary_en: Also hasn't completed the card set.

items.text_th: คราวนี้รอบแรกผมเหลือใบเดียวนานมาก รีหลายรอบมา ได้จากรางวัลก็เยอะ ไม่ออกสักที
items.text_vn: Đợt này bộ đầu mình thiếu đúng 1 thẻ rất lâu, đổi nhiều lần, nhận từ phần thưởng cũng nhiều mà mãi không ra.
items.text_en: This time I was stuck on one last card in the first set for ages. Rerolled many times, got lots from rewards, and it never dropped.
items.summary_vn: Than thiếu 1 thẻ cuối rất lâu dù quay nhiều lần.
items.summary_en: Complains about being stuck on one last card despite many rolls.

items.text_th: ทางนี้ยังไม่ถึงไหนเลย
items.text_vn: Bên này còn chưa tới đâu hết.
items.text_en: I'm nowhere near done.
items.summary_vn: Nói mình còn xa mới đủ thẻ.
items.summary_en: Says they're far from completing the cards.

items.text_th: งานขิงก็มา
items.text_vn: Lại tới màn khoe rồi.
items.text_en: Here comes the flexing.
items.summary_vn: Trêu chủ bài đang khoe.
items.summary_en: Teases the poster for showing off.

items.text_th: เลิกเล่นไปนานvgn คืออะไรครับ
items.text_vn: Lâu rồi không chơi, VNG là gì vậy ạ?
items.text_en: I quit for a long time. What is VNG?
items.summary_vn: Người chơi quay lại hỏi VNG là gì.
items.summary_en: A returning player asks what VNG is.

items.text_th:
ถ้าไม่มีห้องร้าง ยังไงการ์ดก็แทบจะไม่มีโอกาสครบรอบ2เลยใช่ไหมครับ ? เติมก็แล้ว ก็ยังขาด1-2 ใบอยู่ดี
คนที่ไม่มีห้องร้างทำไงกันบ้าง หรือทำใจครับ555
items.text_vn:
Không có phòng bỏ hoang thì gần như không có cơ hội đủ thẻ đợt 2 đúng không ạ? Nạp rồi mà vẫn thiếu 1–2 thẻ.
Ai không có phòng bỏ hoang thì làm sao, hay đành chấp nhận haha.
items.text_en:
Without an abandoned room there's basically no chance to finish the round 2 cards, right? I topped up and I'm still missing 1–2.
What do people without an abandoned room do, or do we just accept it? haha
items.summary_vn: Than không có phòng bỏ hoang thì khó đủ thẻ đợt 2 dù đã nạp tiền.
items.summary_en: Complains it's hard to finish round 2 cards without an abandoned room, even after topping up.

items.text_th: ผมเติมไป4000 ขาดทอง2ใบ55555555
items.text_vn: Mình nạp 4000 rồi mà vẫn thiếu 2 thẻ vàng haha.
items.text_en: I topped up 4,000 and I'm still missing 2 gold cards haha.
items.summary_vn: Nạp 4000 baht vẫn thiếu 2 thẻ vàng.
items.summary_en: Topped up 4,000 baht and still missing 2 gold cards.

items.text_th: เหมือนกันค่า ท้อมากกกๆๆ ค้างทอง 3 ใบ ถอดใจแล้ว
items.text_vn: Y chang luôn, nản cực, kẹt thiếu 3 thẻ vàng, bỏ cuộc rồi.
items.text_en: Same here, so discouraged. Stuck missing 3 gold cards, I've given up.
items.summary_vn: Nản vì thiếu 3 thẻ vàng, đã bỏ cuộc.
items.summary_en: Discouraged by missing 3 gold cards and has given up.

items.text_th: ล่าสุดผมครบละเหมาไปอีกเกือบ2000บาท แต่มันได้เพชรด้วย
items.text_vn: Mới đây mình đủ rồi, mua trọn thêm gần 2000 baht nữa, nhưng được cả kim cương.
items.text_en: I finally completed it, spent almost another 2,000 baht, but at least I got diamonds too.
items.summary_vn: Đã đủ thẻ sau khi chi thêm gần 2000 baht, bù lại có kim cương.
items.summary_en: Completed the set after spending almost 2,000 baht more, got diamonds back.

items.text_th: สวัสดีค่ะ อัปเกรด เอาค่าอะไรดีคะ
items.text_vn: Chào mọi người, nâng cấp thì nên chọn chỉ số nào ạ?
items.text_en: Hi, when upgrading, which stat should I go for?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi nên chọn chỉ số nào khi nâng cấp vũ khí.
items.summary_en: Asks which stat to pick when upgrading the weapon.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: เกมเด้งเป็นพันรอบโดยเฉพาะตอนยิงบอส
items.text_vn: Game văng cả nghìn lần, nhất là lúc bắn boss.
items.text_en: The game has crashed like a thousand times, especially when shooting the boss.
items.summary_vn: Báo game văng liên tục, nhất là khi bắn boss sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Reports constant crashes, especially when shooting the event boss.

items.text_th: พี่อย่าตกใจสัตว์เลี้ยงหนู 😔
items.text_vn: Anh/chị đừng hoảng với thú cưng của em nha 😔
items.text_en: Don't be scared of my pet 😔
items.summary_vn: Khoe ảnh thú cưng với lời đùa.
items.summary_en: Shares a joke photo of their pet.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ไลฟ์สดเมื่อวานกับพี่ใจร้าวสนุกมากๆเลยค่ะขอบคุณนะคะที่ชอบของขวัญที่ส่งให้ (กระเป๋าเอเลี่ยน)
items.text_vn: Buổi live hôm qua với anh Jai Raw vui lắm ạ, cảm ơn anh đã thích món quà em tặng (túi người ngoài hành tinh).
items.text_en: Yesterday's live with Jai Raw was so much fun. Thanks for liking the gift I sent (the alien bag).
items.summary_vn: Creator khen buổi livestream với streamer Jai Raw rất vui.
items.summary_en: A creator says the livestream with streamer Jai Raw was a lot of fun.

items.text_th: มีใครยังเล่นบนPCได้มั้ยคะ เราเปิดเกมหลายรอบแล้วไม่เปิดเลยค่ะ
items.text_vn: Có ai còn chơi được trên PC không ạ? Mình mở game nhiều lần mà không lên.
items.text_en: Can anyone still play on PC? I've tried opening the game many times and it won't start.
items.summary_vn: Báo không mở được game trên PC.
items.summary_en: Reports the game won't open on PC.

items.text_th: เราเล่นสตรีมไม่ได้ค่ะ เลยลบเกม ลงใหม่
items.text_vn: Mình chơi trên Steam không được nên đã xoá game cài lại.
items.text_en: I couldn't play on Steam either, so I deleted the game and reinstalled.
items.summary_vn: Không chơi được trên Steam nên phải xoá cài lại.
items.summary_en: Couldn't play on Steam, so reinstalled the game.

items.text_th: เล่นได้แล้วบอกทีนะคะ โหลดในสตรีมโหลดไม่ได้เลยค่ะ
items.text_vn: Ai chơi được rồi báo mình với nha, tải trên Steam không được luôn.
items.text_en: Let me know when it works, I can't download it on Steam at all.
items.summary_vn: Không tải được game trên Steam.
items.summary_en: Can't download the game on Steam.

items.text_th: ผมเล่นได้ปกตินะงับ
items.text_vn: Mình vẫn chơi bình thường nha.
items.text_en: It works fine for me.
items.summary_vn: Cho biết mình chơi PC bình thường.
items.summary_en: Says it works fine for them.

items.text_th: บนคอมปกตินะครับ มือถือหลุดกระจาย
items.text_vn: Trên máy tính thì bình thường, còn điện thoại thì văng liên tục.
items.text_en: PC is fine, but on mobile it crashes all over the place.
items.summary_vn: PC bình thường nhưng điện thoại văng game liên tục.
items.summary_en: PC works but the game keeps crashing on mobile.

items.text_th: ช่วงเวลาแห่งการกักตุน🤣😂ราคานี้ไม่มีมาบ่อยๆเด้อ
items.text_vn: Tới giờ tích trữ rồi 🤣😂 giá này không phải lúc nào cũng có đâu nha.
items.text_en: Stock-up time 🤣😂 prices like this don't come often.
items.summary_vn: Khoe mua gói giá hời trên web shop VNG.
items.summary_en: Shows off buying a cheap pack on the VNG web shop.

items.text_th: ซื้อเว็ปไหนหรอครับ
items.text_vn: Mua ở web nào vậy ạ?
items.text_en: Which website did you buy it from?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi mua gói ở trang web nào.
items.summary_en: Asks which website sells the pack.

items.text_th: เดือนนี้คุ้มหน่อย3ตัว 300
items.text_vn: Tháng này đáng tiền chút, 3 cái 300.
items.text_en: This month is pretty good value, 3 for 300.
items.summary_vn: Khen gói tháng này đáng tiền (3 cái 300 baht).
items.summary_en: Says this month's deal is good value (3 for 300 baht).

items.text_th: เรากดซื้อแล้วเก็บไว้ในกล่องจดหมายได้กี่วันหรอคะ
items.text_vn: Mua xong để trong hộp thư được bao nhiêu ngày vậy ạ?
items.text_en: After buying, how many days can it stay in the mailbox?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi vật phẩm mua được giữ trong hộp thư bao lâu.
items.summary_en: Asks how long purchases stay in the mailbox.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: แบบนี้คือโอเคไหมครับ หรือต้องเอาอะไรออก ใส่อะไรเพิ่มครับ
items.text_vn: Như này ổn chưa ạ, hay phải bỏ cái gì ra, thêm cái gì vào ạ?
items.text_en: Is this OK, or should I remove or add something?
items.summary_vn: Hỏi bộ chỉ số nâng cấp vũ khí đã ổn chưa.
items.summary_en: Asks if their weapon upgrade stats are OK.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: แถว2-3 เปลี่ยนเป็นความเร็วครับ
items.text_vn: Dòng 2–3 đổi sang tốc độ nha.
items.text_en: Change rows 2–3 to speed.
items.summary_vn: Khuyên đổi dòng 2–3 sang chỉ số tốc độ.
items.summary_en: Suggests switching rows 2–3 to speed.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: อัพเซ็ตเดียวกับผม ก็ทำที่ 1 ได้อยู่นะ
items.text_vn: Nâng giống bộ của mình, vẫn lên top 1 được đó.
items.text_en: Same build as mine, you can still get first place with it.
items.summary_vn: Nói bộ chỉ số này vẫn đạt hạng 1 được.
items.summary_en: Says this build can still reach first place.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)

items.text_th: ช่วยด้วยย ‼️ หากล่องสุดท้ายไม่เจอ พลีสสส🙏🏻
items.text_vn: Cứu với ‼️ tìm không ra hộp cuối, làm ơnnn 🙏🏻
items.text_en: Help ‼️ I can't find the last box, pleaseee 🙏🏻
items.summary_vn: Nhờ giúp tìm hộp tiếp tế cuối cùng trong sự kiện.
items.summary_en: Asks for help finding the last supply box in the event.

items.text_th: ตรงข้างๆนี้หรือป่าวคะ
items.text_vn: Có phải ngay bên cạnh chỗ này không?
items.text_en: Is it right next to this spot?
items.summary_vn: Gợi ý vị trí hộp nằm ngay bên cạnh.
items.summary_en: Suggests the box might be right next to that spot.

items.text_th: หลังรถนี่เอง555
items.text_vn: Thì ra là sau xe, haha.
items.text_en: It was behind the car, haha.
items.summary_vn: Đã tìm ra hộp cuối ở sau xe.
items.summary_en: Found the last box behind the car.

items.text_th: หาไม่เจอจริงค่ะ555555555 ท้อมาก
items.text_vn: Tìm không ra thật luôn haha, nản ghê.
items.text_en: I really can't find it hahaha, so discouraged.

items.text_th:
หาคนมี รถตุ๊กตุ๊กไทยสีน้ำเงินหลังคาดำ มาช่วยถ่ายคลิป TikTok ครับ 
 ขอคนที่เรียกรถออกมาขับและให้ผมนั่งไปด้วยได้ อยากถ่ายช็อตขึ้นรถกับขับเที่ยวด้วยกัน ใช้เวลาประมาณ 20–30 นาที ถ้าสะดวก ทักมาพร้อมรูปหรือคลิปรถในเกม ช่วงเวลาที่ว่าง และค่าช่วยถ่ายถ้ามีครับ เม้นไว้เลยเดี๋ยวทักไปครับ
items.text_vn:
Tìm người có xe tuk tuk Thái màu xanh mui đen giúp quay clip TikTok.
Cần người gọi xe ra lái và cho mình ngồi cùng, muốn quay cảnh lên xe và chạy dạo chung, mất khoảng 20–30 phút. Ai tiện thì nhắn kèm ảnh/clip xe trong game, giờ rảnh và phí nhờ quay nếu có. Cứ bình luận, mình sẽ nhắn lại.
items.text_en:
Looking for someone with the blue Thai tuk tuk with a black roof to help film a TikTok clip.
I need someone to bring out the tuk tuk and let me ride along so I can film getting in and cruising together, about 20–30 minutes. If you can, message me with a pic or clip of your in-game tuk tuk, when you're free, and your fee if any. Comment and I'll message you.
items.summary_vn: Tìm người có xe tuk tuk xanh mui đen để quay clip TikTok chung.
items.summary_en: Looks for someone with a blue black-roof tuk tuk to film a TikTok clip together.
items.theme: Hoạt động và tính năng trong game
items.topic: Activities (fishing, bugs, pets, housing, jobs, minigames)
